sloka: तौ द्रष्टुकामः सङ्ग्रामे परस्परगतौ बली।शूरः स रावणभ्राता तस्थौ सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि ।। ६.९०.२ ।।
transliteration: tau draṣṭukāmaḥ saṅgrāme parasparagatau balī।śūraḥ sa rāvaṇabhrātā tasthau saṅgrāmamūrdhani ।। 6.90.2 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
translations.hindi: शत्रुनाशकारी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी धीरज धारण कर वानरों के उससीप बैठे हुए विभीषण से बोले
